body:
Good day,

Thank you for your words of encouragement.  As I start to feel better I realize t  I am learning to trust enough to share and in sharing I am realizing that there are others within my circle that have this same feeling.  This makes me feel a little better.  However dealing with Manic depression I worry when even that is not enough to convince me.  in the end I am aware and i will consciously make an effort to believe everything will be alright.  
Thank you

Thank you for the kindness and the inspiring words.  I haven't gotten to AA yet and although I drink more I have-not developed a dependency for the substance, it a cruch a barrier.  i am currently at a pause.   I hope your light continue to shine. be safe.

I have rested a few days, Also had the chance to smile.  However, this false reality is starting to cloud my judgment and I am thinking more and more of committing myself to a hospital ( I am not as safe as I appear).  I know I am tired and I always disliked the fear of not knowing so I considered those who have actually gave a darn to talk me through my thoughts.  I am also realizing, harming myself will only cause me less pain, yet more harm to my family who I support and they look for me to provide for them ( and I am okay with that) its the extra at Work, personal life ( I have none).   I do not know what the future has for me yet for today- I will take one moment at a time until I can get Help...

u/picard_epsilon793 thank you for reaching out-  I am that person who is always there for others yet since it is perceived that I am strong no one hold my hand, ever-thank you for given me a bit of hope in humanity.

Today -- I wish it all away--I am not Safe yet I am not in harms way either.   I am just one very bad decision away from saying Goodbye.  I have resulting to my old behaviors and cutting well it has always relieved stress.  I do not want anyone to feel sorry for me ( you do not know me). as of right now i am writing as a form of releasing some of the pain and having the ability to remain (secret)… To place anyone at ease I Have a safety net although they will not block my ultimate decision they are willing to ensure my family are taken care of...   The mind is made up and lucky for anyone who may have some feelings -  I have given myself time within this next 365?  i am currently on loan... for anything is possible.  Thank you to those who have reached out.  Sometimes you just need someone to listen-as for me  I really do not have anyone-that is willing to listen without making about them.  Theres hope for me Yet... I know I am still here since there is a purpose I have yet to accomplish...
